answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the knoll log shows the live set and the forge audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 220 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 282 aliases alive hence means 282 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the echo quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
